## 🐱💻 Glitch Visualizer — your name, your pictures, your words

A glitch-malware audio visualizer for DJ streams. Originally made by **DJMackilla**.

### ⬇️ Which file do I download?

| Your computer | Download | Then |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** (easiest) | **Glitch-Visualizer-Setup.exe** | Double-click → it installs and opens. Shortcuts land on your desktop + Start menu. |
| Windows, no install | Glitch-Visualizer.exe | Double-click to run. |
| **Mac** | **Glitch-Visualizer-Mac.zip** | Unzip → drag into Applications → right-click → **Open** → **Open** (first time only). |

> Windows "protected your PC"? → **More info → Run anyway** (the app isn't code-signed).
> Mac "can't be opened"? → **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.

### 🎛️ First launch
1. Type your DJ name
2. Add your pictures (tick **real face** on photos of real people)
3. Optional: your group's logo
4. Write your own words — or hit **Fill with the example** for the cat-malware theme
5. **SAVE & START**, then play music in Spotify, YouTube, VirtualDJ, rekordbox, Serato… it reacts by itself on Windows.

📺 **OBS:** add a **Window Capture** → *Glitch Visualizer*. Full guide in the [README](https://github.com/YGMackilla/glitch-visualizer#readme).
